summary: Clackamas County crow's nest and camp listed for 1934 by the Oregon Department of Forestry; listed abandoned in the 1940s; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Sources list it as abandoned; no source we read describes what remains.

events.note: Listed as a crow's nest and camp
firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1940s; the Oregon Lookouts index lists the crow's nest as abandoned

evidence.supports: A crow's nest and camp are listed for 1934, and the lookout is given as abandoned in the 1940s
Site is about five miles east of Sandy in Clackamas County
Site is in Clackamas County, Oregon
Agency is the Oregon Department of Forestry
The Forest Lookouts directory lists the Clackamas County lookouts under that county heading
The Forest Lookouts directory lists Devils Backbone among Clackamas County lookouts

evidence.supports: The Forest Lookouts page gives the code 2S-5E-11 for the site, under the Oregon Department of Forestry

The Oregon index classes the site as a crow's nest site

corrections.why: firelookout.com and the Oregon Lookouts index both list this crow's nest as abandoned. Neither source says the structure was removed.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Sources are one dated entry (1934 crow's nest and camp), an abandonment date in the 1940s, a directory listing and a one-line Forest Lookouts entry. Two WebSearch calls found nothing about this lookout. A Jonsrud Viewpoint result in Sandy mentions a ridge also called Devil's Backbone; it is a different place and was not used. The brief's status gone is not supported; sources say abandoned. The story is at the short end of the length range because the evidence is thin. Verification 2026-10-10: the story's 'location code' label was changed to 'code', since the page does not label 2S-5E-11, and a Clackamas County heading quote was added to the directory evidence.
